turns.content:
Interesting! The error shows something very suspicious - the date header has null bytes (`\x00`) inserted in it: `b'Date: Thu, 01 \x00ct 2026 00:16:24 GMT'`. The "Oct" has become "01 \x00ct" - the 'O' has been replaced with a null byte!

This suggests something is corrupting data at the system level. Let me check if there are any unusual system configurations or processes affecting network operations.
